{{Quote|Take 'em away, Stan!|Imperial stormtrooper on Tol Ado|<ref name="Jedi's Honor">''[[Jedi's Honor]]''</ref>}}
'''Stan''' was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] operator on the prison world of [[Tol Ado]]. The Imperial worked in the [[Deathblock]] carrying away the bodies of prisoners who had died under interrogation.

==Biography==
{{RPG}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Stan was carrying bodies with the assistance of several droids. Luke Skywalker, who had been captured by Imperials and deposited in the [[Deathblock]] was able to feign his death by slowing down his vital signs through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. His "dead" body was placed in a litter and attached to Stan's repulsorcraft who carried him alongside several other dead bodies to a processing center. Unknown to Stan, Skywalker slipped off of his litter and escaped into the corridors of the prison.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Stan was created by [[Troy Denning]] and appeared in one of the [[Roleplaying game|role-playing]] strands of the [[1990]] [[West End Games]] role-playing supplement ''[[Jedi's Honor]]''. The branch of the story in which Stan is encountered is the result of the reader causing Luke Skywalker to be captured by the Empire. As this role-playing strand results in Skywalker failing his mission despite escaping the prison, it can be assumed that Stan's role in the story is non-canon whether or not his presence on Tol Ado is canon.

==Appearances==
